materials.name: RC_Leather_Material_v04
materials.color_space: Scene-linear RGB, Rec.709/sRGB primaries; no display transform baked
materials.unity_mapping: Preliminary Built-In material: preserve linear colors; Metallic direct; Smoothness=1-Roughness is an initial approximation. Emission color and multiplier separate. Double-sided thin glyphs/bookmark need correct backface lighting. Silver/crystal appearance depends on environment and tonemapping; not a validated Valheim shader.

emission_behavior: Constant independent emission for primary runes, secondary seal and clasp crystal. No normal/world/camera-dependent nodes. Crystal facets are actual geometry; they receive ordinary lighting. No textures/UV or baked masks required for current materials. Bookmark symbol shares matte parchment material, zero emission.
